title: Acknowledgements
intro: Alberta Expeditions uses the following mapping data, imagery, terrain data, and software.
attributionNote: This page supplements source credits. Some providers require attribution to remain visible directly on the map.

basemap.title: Vector basemap
basemap.description: Basemap styles are served by OpenFreeMap and use OpenMapTiles and OpenStreetMap data.

imagery.title: Satellite imagery
imagery.description: Esri World Imagery source credit: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community.

terrain.title: Terrain elevation
terrain.description: Terrain tiles are provided by Mapterhorn. Its attribution page lists the underlying data sources and their licenses.

mappingLibrary.title: Mapping software
mappingLibrary.description: The interactive map is rendered with MapLibre GL JS.
